name: ZIMMER US INC
naics_description: MEDICAL, DENTAL, AND HOSPITAL EQUIPMENT AND SUPPLIES MERCHANT WHOLESALERS
brief_text:
Three detectors fired for Zimmer US Inc. The Benford test found the leading digits of award amounts deviate significantly from expected natural frequencies, with digits 2, 3, and 4 appearing far more often than theory predicts and digit 1 appearing much less frequently. The Isolation Forest algorithm flagged the entity as a multivariate outlier based on its feature profile. The sole-source concentration detector identified that this entity wins awards through sole-source procurement at a rate dramatically exceeding its peer group in medical equipment wholesale.

The Benford test showed a KS statistic of 0.244 with p-value of 1.65e-18 across 350 transactions. Sole-source awards comprised 342 of 351 lifetime awards, or 97.7 percent, compared to a median of 1.2 percent among 122 peers in the same NAICS code, yielding a z-score of 3.30. The Isolation Forest anomaly score was 0.759 on a scale where higher indicates greater outlier status. The entity has accumulated 18.3 million dollars across its lifetime award history.

These statistical signals warrant scrutiny but do not constitute proof of fraud. Medical equipment suppliers may legitimately receive sole-source awards due to specialized product requirements or existing supply relationships with DoD. The Benford deviation could reflect genuine business practices in pricing or contract structuring rather than manipulation. The small peer group size and industry-specific procurement patterns should be considered when evaluating whether these anomalies reflect actual misconduct or normal variation in this sector.
